retrieved_evidence.source: NICE CG150 (suspected acute appendicitis) - danger signs for urgent surgical review; dataset's own ultrasound findings (Perforation, Appendicular_Abscess) serve as record-level triggers
retrieved_evidence.chunk_text: Generalized peritonitis, signs of perforation, palpable abscess/mass, persistent vomiting with systemic illness, or clinical deterioration are urgent surgical red flags that must be escalated rather than watchfully waited on.
